name: Offroad Dirt Racing 3D 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Forget about Formula 1 or Motorbike racing, jump inside your dirt buggy instead and race around the track at break-neck speeds! Offroad 3D Dirt Racing is a fun racing simulator that lets you compete against three other opponents in 3 laps of fun filled and action packed racing.
